adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces `SiteSetting.embeddable_host` as a plain string (config/site_settings.yml) and then compares it via strict string equality to `URI(...).host` in two places: `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` (`URI(request.referer).host != SiteSetting.embeddable_host`) and `TopicRetriever#invalid_host?` (`SiteSetting.embeddable_host != URI(@embed_url).host`). If an admin configures the setting as a full URL like `https://example.com` or includes a port (`example.com:3000`), it will not match `URI(...).host` (which is just `example.com`), causing embedding/retrieval to fail. There is no normalization/validation in the diff to prevent or correct this input.
